name: Cosmax

figures.source: MFDS — #1 in Korea by production value. PRODUCTION basis: factory-gate output, not comparable to the NET_REALISATION revenue rows above

read: Korea's largest cosmetics ODM — KRW 1.61tn of MFDS-registered production value in 2025 and KRW 2.399tn of consolidated revenue (DART), a record year, up from KRW 2.16tn in 2024. The two figures sit on different bases (production value is factory-gate output, revenue is company net realisation) and must not be netted. Cosmax is the reason the new-entrant threat in Korean BPC reads high: the manufacturing capability behind almost every indie K-brand is rentable, so a brand can be formulated and produced without owning a plant. For an entrant considering a made-in-Korea line for India, this is the supply-side counterpart to Limese's model — but no India-specific Cosmax activity is recorded in this repo.
